summary: Adds scripts/cost_log.py (with tests, written first and seen failing on the missing module), which prints one markdown row for a merge request or for pipelines by id from the public GitLab API, reusing gitlab_ci_facts; credit columns stay 'human' and unmeasurable values stay null. Adds a GitLab.pipeline method. Adds docs/submission/cost-log.md and ADR 0009 (proposed). Verified on 2026-10-24: SCI spec v1.1.0 (sci.greensoftware.foundation) states no ISO number; ISO/IEC 21031:2024 is listed by the IEC webstore; GitLab x86-64 hosted runners run on Google Cloud in us-east1 and us-east5; Google region grid intensity 2025: us-east1 579, us-east5 343, us-central1 432 gCO2eq/kWh, not labelled location or market based; Cloud Carbon Footprint GCP 0.71 to 4.26 W per vCPU and PUE 1.1 with no numeric embodied value; GitLab documents no API for credit usage. M is not estimated and the score is labelled SCI without M. The experiment section of the ADR is not written yet.
next: Write the SCI experiment design once the full specification is available
